title: Develop exit strategy
goal: Every asset at or near the end of its useful life, warranty or lease has a date, a costed keep, repair, replace or do-without proposal, and a decision in front of the founder.

steps.do: List every item past, or within six months of, its useful life, warranty end or lease end, each with its age, what it has cost in repairs in the last twelve months, who holds it and whether the work still needs it at all.

For each of those items put keep, repair, replace and do without side by side over the next two years with the cost of each, the time lost when it fails, and the resale or trade-in value the item still has, recommend one and raise it to the founder, who decides.

Attach each costed proposal to the decision it settles, note which items hold data and so cannot simply be sold, and recommend to the finance lead the order of replacement across the next two quarters.

done_criteria.check: Does every item past or near the end of its useful life, warranty or lease have a costed keep, repair, replace or do-without proposal in front of the founder, with its resale value named?
